title: Flumior
description:
Summary:
The Flumior Mod Pack enhances Minecraft by optimizing performance, improving world generation, and adding new structures and mechanics, resulting in a more engaging and enjoyable gameplay experience.
body:
Generation
Terralith, Tidal Towns, Villages & Pillages, Towns and Towers — introduce new biomes, towns, villages, and other exciting locations into the Minecraft world.
Structures
YUNG's Better End Island, YUNG's Better Jungle Temples, YUNG's Better Ocean Monuments, YUNG's Better Nether Fortresses, YUNG's Better Strongholds, YUNG's Better Dungeons, YUNG's Better Mineshafts, YUNG's Better Witch Huts, YUNG's Better Desert Temples, YUNG's Bridges, YUNG's Extras — significantly enhance and expand existing Minecraft structures, adding more variety and depth to exploration.
New Mechanics
SereneSeasons, ToughAsNails — introduce new survival mechanics and seasonal changes, making the gameplay more diverse and challenging.
Enhancements
AmbientSounds, Dynamic Lights, Iris, Continuity — enhance visual and sound elements, creating a more immersive and aesthetically pleasing game.
Just Enough Items, Jade, AppleSkin, Shulker Box Tooltip — improve game convenience by providing detailed information on items, food, and inventory.
CreativeCore, Entity Texture Features, Entity Model Features, NotEnoughAnimations, Chat Heads — add new animations, textures, and visual improvements for characters and mobs.
